events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is extending its early losses in mid-market trading on Monday, reversing some of the gains in the previous two sessions, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street on Friday. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling below the 8,850.00 level, with weakness in gold mining and financial stocks partially offset by gains in energy stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mixed
events.description: Asian markets are trading mixed on Monday, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street on Friday, amid weakness in technology stock which mirrored their peers on tech-heavy Nasdaq on renewed concerns about the AI trade. Markets also keep an eye on the ongoing discussions between Qatari mediators and Iranian officials to end hostilities in the Middle East which could ease supply concerns.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Higher As AI Selloff Deepens, Oil Prices Ease
events.description:
Indian shares look set to open higher on Monday, with information technology stocks in the spotlight after the tech-heavy Nasdaq plunged to its lowest closing level in three months on Friday amid renewed concerns about the artificial intelligence trade.
 
Additionally, ongoing discussions involving Iranian officials and Qatari mediators have raised hopes of possible breakthrough that could ease supply concerns and improve the outlook for global energy markets.

events.title: Thai Stock Market May Test Support At 1,500 Points
events.description: The Thai stock market has finished lower in four straight sessions, sliding more than 60 points or 3.7 percent in that span. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just beneath the 1,520-point plateau and it's looking at another soft start again on Monday.

events.title: China Manufacturing PMI Eases In September - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in China continued to expand in October, albeit at a slower pace, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Monday with a Performance of Manufacturing Index score of 52.0.

events.title: Japanese Market Slightly Lower
events.description: The Japanese stock market is slightly lower on Monday, extending the losses in the previous session, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street on Friday. The Nikkei 225 is falling below the 63,250 level, with weakness in automakers and financial stocks partially offset by gains in exporter stocks.

events.title: Losses May Accelerate For Indonesia Stock Market
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has finished lower in two straight sessions, slumping more than 225 points or 4 percent along the way. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,050-point plateau and it may see continued consolidation on Monday.

events.title: Hong Kong Stock Market May Head South Again On Monday
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market has alternated between positive and negative finishes through the last four trading days since the end of the two-day winning streak in which it had picked up more than 275 points or 1.2 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just beneath the 23,300-point plateau although it's likely to hand those gains back on Monday.

events.title: Australian Markets Modestly Lower
events.description: The Australian stock market is modestly lower on Monday, reversing some of the gains in the previous two sessions, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street on Friday. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling below the 8,900.00 level, with weakness in mining and technology stocks partially offset by gains in financial stocks.

events.title: China Stock Market May See Continued Consolidation
events.description: The China stock market has finished lower in two consecutive trading days, falling more than 80 points or 2.2 percent along the way. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just beneath the 3,600-point plateau and it may extend those losses on Monday.

events.title: Malaysia Manufacturing PMI Climbs Into Expansion Territory - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in Malaysia moved to expansion in October, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Monday with a Performance of Manufacturing Index score of 51.0.

events.title: Japan Manufacturing PMI Slips To 53.3 In October - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in Japan continued to expand in October, albeit at a slower pace, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Monday with a Performance of Manufacturing Index score of 53.3.

events.title: South Korea Manufacturing Sector Ebbs In October - S&P Global
events.description: The manufacturing sector in South Korea continued to expand in October, albeit at a slower pace, the latest survey from S&P Global revealed on Monday with a Performance of Manufacturing Index score of 51.3.
